hero.title: Empowering Farms, Connecting Skilled Workers
hero.subtitle: Direct, fair, and reliable hiring platform connecting farmers needing seasonal hands with experienced agricultural workers in their local area.

features.title: Why Choose AgriConnect?
features.subtitle: Built specifically for rural communities and agricultural work dynamics.
features.f1Desc: Discover jobs and workers within your village, taluka, or custom kilometer radius with instant GPS matching.
features.f2Desc: Direct connection between farmers and laborers with 100% transparent daily wages and zero hidden cuts.
features.f3Desc: Community-driven review and reputation system ensuring reliable farm hands and trustworthy employers.
features.f4Desc: Simple interface available in English, हिंदी, and मराठी designed for easy mobile use.

howItWorks.title: How AgriConnect Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Simple 3-step workflow for both farmers and workers.
howItWorks.farmerStep1Desc: Specify crop, work type (Harvesting, Sowing, Irrigation), dates, workers needed, and daily wage.
howItWorks.farmerStep2Desc: Browse applications, view worker profiles, previous ratings, and select best matched workers.
howItWorks.farmerStep3Desc: Direct communication via chat/call, track work progress, and rate workers upon completion.
howItWorks.workerStep1Desc: List your farming skills, experience, preferred wage, and village/town location.
howItWorks.workerStep2Desc: Filter jobs by distance, wage, and work type. Submit application with 1-click.
howItWorks.workerStep3Desc: Get accepted, work on trusted farms, receive fair wages, and build high ratings for regular work.

cta.title: Ready to Transform Your Agricultural Hiring?
cta.subtitle: Join thousands of farmers and workers across India today.

footer.desc: AgriConnect connects farmers with verified agricultural workers, bridging labor shortages and ensuring fair wages.
